narr: Widespread moderate to heavy rainfall occurred across much of the eastern mountains and adjacent locations along the I-25 corridor on this day. Rainfall as high as 2 to 5 inches was observed in many locations, with flash flooding occurring across parts of Pueblo county.
ev: Off duty National Weather Service Employee reports multiple cars stranded in flood waters near Pueblo Riverwalk and Santa Fe Avenue.
Off duty National Weather Service meteorologist reports underpass flooded and impassable at the entrance to Pueblo Memorial Airport.
Off duty National Weather Service meteorologist reports substantial underpass flooding along U.S. Highway 50 south of Pueblo Memorial Airport.
Flooding along U.S. Highway 50 between Colorado Highway 47 and areas south of Pueblo Depot. Reported by Colorado Department of Transportation.

Law enforcement reports multiple areas of significant flash flooding in the vicinity of the intersection of U.S. Highway 50 and Colorado Highway 47. This includes 4 feet of standing water and roads washed out.
Law enforcement indicates that flash flooding continues across eastern parts of the Pueblo area, though not as significant as earlier in the night.
